items.title: Corning (GLW) To Show High Density Optical Chip Links At ECOC 2026
items.summary: Corning (NYSE:GLW), Qualcomm and Lumentum plan to showcase a high-density die to die optical connectivity solution at ECOC 2026. The joint demo targets AI scale up architectures that require higher bandwidth, lower latency and tighter power budgets for chip interconnects. The ECOC 2026 presentation will highlight massively parallel optical D2D links paired with high density fiber to support advanced AI data centers.
